liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (8 reviews): Reviewer ranks this Playin' among the top three versions, possibly the best; Highlight of the set: a very intense jam that goes far out with the band firing hard [5][6][7][8][10][11][12][14]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Audible flatulence during He's Gone strikes the reviewer as funny [14]

## The recordings

- **gd72-11-18.set2-sbd.cotsman.9002.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 94 min; rated 4.34/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: The tape of He's Gone is clipped in several places, making it harder to listen to; Recording is not perfectly crisp; Sound quality is somewhat hissy [5][7][10][12][15]
- **gd1972-11-18.sbd-set2.lai.9182.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 94 min; rated 4.4/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd1972-11-18.123077.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 95 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this show was reportedly a favorite of Latvala [6]
- Reviewer rates this version equal to the 8/27/72 one, but it breaks free earlier and gets spacier [4]
- Not a typical 1972 Playin'; the song has traveled a long way since the start of the year [6]
- Reviewer suggests comparing this Playin' with the one played the following night [7]
- Reviewer thinks this Playin' surpasses the Veneta one; rest of show is judged standard 1972 [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-11-18.set2-sbd.cotsman.9002.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Only the second set of the show circulates in this soundboard source; Second set only; chain soundboard to MC to cassette to DAT to CD to EAC to SHN, edited and encoded by J. Cotsman [1][5]
- **gd1972-11-18.sbd-set2.lai.9182.shnf**: source: Owsley MC >> ? >> D >> CD [2]
- **gd1972-11-18.123077.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.merchbar.com: [Grateful Dead 11/18/72 HOFHEINZ PAVILION HOUSTON TX Vinyl Record - 180 Gram Pressing](https://www.merchbar.com/rock-alternative/grateful-dead/grateful-dead-11-18-72-hofheinz-pavilion-houston-tx-vinyl-record-180-gram-pressing) [17]
- Poster by Red on Black: [THE GRATEFUL DEAD - 11/18/72 HOFHEINZ PAVILION, HOUSTON TX VINYL - ALBUM REVIEW — musomuso.com](https://musomuso.com/news/the-grateful-dead-111872-hofheinz-pavilion-houston-tx-vinyl-album-review) [18]
- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Houston, Texas 11-18-1972](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27317357421/) [19]
